description.value: The study examined neural and behavioural responses to visual sexual cues in patients with Parkinson’s disease with hypersexuality compared with Parkinson’s disease control patients, including scans in ON and OFF dopamine medication states.

spans.text: Here, we have studied a group of 12 patients with Parkinson’s disease with hypersexuality using a functional magnetic resonance imaging block design exposing participants to both sexual, other reward-related and neutral visual cues.

value: we hypothesized that exposure to visual sexual cues would trigger increased sexual desire in patients with Parkinson’s disease with hypersexuality that would correspond to changes in brain activity in regions linked to dopaminergically stimulated sexual motivation.

blood oxygen level-dependent (BOLD) signal alterations

We sought to investigate this by examining blood oxygen level-dependent (BOLD) signal alterations with functional MRI (by comparing responses in an ON medication scan with an OFF medication scan) and correlate the imaging results with behavioural assessments of sexual motivation.

These behavioural changes corresponded to significant blood oxygen level-dependent signal changes in regions within limbic, paralimbic, temporal, occipital, somatosensory and prefrontal cortices that correspond to emotional, cognitive, autonomic, visual and motivational processes.

source_definition.value: Visual cue condition consisting of the experimental image category presented in the block-design functional MRI paradigm; contrasts included each reward condition versus neutral pictures and sexual cues versus other rewards.

spans.text: First-level analysis was performed at the single participant level where individual contrasts were created in a general linear model for each reward condition minus baseline (neutral pictures) and for sex minus other rewards (sex versus other rewards).

model_settings.value: Second-level group random-effects analysis of first-level general linear model contrasts; six motion and nuisance parameters were included at first level. Statistical threshold P < 0.001 uncorrected with cluster extent greater than 10 voxels and false-discovery-rate correction at P < 0.05.

spans.text: The general linear model included six motion and nuisance parameters, accounting for movement and other nuisance artefacts occurring in three directions of translation (displacement) and three axes of rotation ( x , y , z translation and x , y , z rotation) for each run.
